source.title: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs
source.subtitle: The Year of the Lord in Liturgy and Folklore
source.author: Francis X. Weiser, S.J.
source.rights: Still copyrighted. Inventory contains original factual labels, never copied extended book text.
caveats: 1958 historical author, not current discipline or current ritual law.
Foreword explicitly excludes independent folklore treatment of Holy Family, Christ the King, Sacred Heart, Holy Name.
Some Catholic-adopted practices are of Protestant origin (notably the German Advent wreath).
Some folklore includes rejected magical claims; EXCLUDE never auto-publishes.
No source book can establish actual practice in every diocese or parish.

reconciliation: Do not mint 45 canonical Customs Atlas records from these 45 research facts.
Existing mass, pray, special-days and calendar owners take precedence.
Keep all SOT-07 negative-knowledge holds, law/indulgence validation and place-pin restrictions.
Crosscheck any candidate against the 1962 Calendar and geographical evidence prior to publication.
PR #1512 independently proposes BLSS-002/003/004; this research batch does not duplicate them.

2026-10-20 Christmas/Epiphany batch: Weiser independently discusses St John wine (BLSS-003 pending in PR #1512), DOM-001 parental New Year blessing, DOM-003 Epiphany water, DOM-004 home blessing and DOM-008 negative-knowledge. These are cross-reference observations, not novel canonical customs.

Avoid importing source records referring to Catholic carols/music as new office/music modules or old pre-1958 canonical fasting as present-day obligations. Epiphany chalk must remain geographically contextual and blocked as universal.
